households.name: Dale & Marilyn Kowalski
households.tagline: Auto-plant pension, single-life payout, 7 years apart
households.story: Moved down from Michigan in 2015. Dale took the single-life option on his pension because the check was bigger. Marilyn keeps the books.

households.name: Joan Pederson
households.tagline: Widowed teacher, solid pension, worried about care
households.story: Retired Minnesota schoolteacher, widowed in 2021. Plays bridge three days a week. Her mother needed five years of memory care.

households.name: Rick & Sue Alvarez
households.tagline: Just retired, big 401(k), first decade decides everything
households.story: Engineer and nurse from the Chicago suburbs, retired this spring. Big travel plans, a cabin in Wisconsin, and almost everything in pre-tax money.

households.name: Gary & Linda Hoffman
households.tagline: Social Security, a modest IRA, no room for surprises
households.story: Ran a hardware store in Iowa for 30 years and sold it for less than they hoped. Both claimed Social Security early. Linda still works mornings at the rec center.
